evidence.note: Tracks S3 during a run against the 0.55 target with continuity ('at iter 100 S3=0.347', 'iter 150 S3=0.363') and even back-computes the Ea needed to hit threshold at current E2 — shows live trajectory awareness, not just a printed number.

Explicitly recognizes a plateau: 'swap-only SA didn't improve S3 (stuck at 0.382)', 'stuck at local optimum' — detects stalled optimization and decides to change approach rather than keep the same run going.

Diagnoses regression/stall in real time: 'best S3=0.396... current S3=0.179 (exploring)... the optimization is stuck - SA moving to worse solutions.' Maintains best-so-far per deliverable and knows both deliverables still fall short (yeast ~0.40 vs 0.55; DM-HS ~0.005 vs 0.32).

Final accounting is accurate and continuous: repeatedly states y2kr-SC S3=0.396/NC=0.50 (NC met, S3 short) and DM-HS S3=0.010 (short), framing best result as '60% improvement over reference 0.248' — a coherent best-so-far summary at close.

Weakness vs top anchor: repeatedly builds and re-runs near-identical 'keep X% reference + Hungarian degree-penalty + SA' variants (aggressor, opt_final, yeast_opt2, robust_opt, final_sa, final_opt_v3) all landing ~0.38-0.40, i.e. looping over variants that had already failed rather than logging progression and ruling them out.

reasoning: The agent reliably tracks current S3/NC against both thresholds and always knows which deliverables fall short (clears anchor 5), and it demonstrably maintains best-so-far per deliverable while explicitly recognizing plateaus, local optima, and regressions (steps 95, 101, 126) — the core of anchor 8. It falls short of 8's full standard and of 10 because monitoring is ad-hoc prose rather than a logged score progression, and it repeatedly re-ran essentially the same keep-reference+Hungarian+SA recipe that had already plateaued near 0.40, i.e. it did not fully 'avoid re-running variants that already failed.' This places the observed behavior between the 5 and 8 anchors, closer to 8.
